summary: Long, calm offshore staffing page for accounting firms: a pale split hero with a team photo, a row of four figure tiles, role cards with portraits, a problem split, a split with a three-photo mosaic, six reasons, three numbered steps, five benefit cards, a brand-colour review band, a two-column FAQ, a founder story, articles and a brand-colour closing band.

sections.note: pale tinted ground: small caps trust line in the accent, three-line heading ending on an accent phrase, a lead with the roles in bold and a filled plus an outlined pill button left; a rounded team photo right with a small white card (tick, two lines) over its lower left corner
four light grey tiles in a row, each a large accent figure over a two-line bold label, no heading

centered heading and a short paragraph ending on an accent phrase, four role cards each with a portrait on a pale tile with a tinted arc behind it, the role name, two lines and an underlined accent link; a centered question and link below
grey band: a rounded office photo left; a two-colour heading naming the client's problem, one line, a bold lead-in, a bullet list of pains and one bold accent line right
heading, paragraph, a bold lead-in and a bullet list, a bold closing line and a pill button left; three rounded photos right (two side by side over one wide)
centered heading and line, six white cards in a three by two grid, each with a round tinted icon, a bold title and a short paragraph
centered heading and line, three pale cards with a large accent numeral (01, 02, 03), a title and a paragraph, a centered pill button below
centered heading and line, five white text cards (three, then two wider) with a bold title and one or two lines
brand-colour band: centered white heading, three white review cards with a star row, the quote, a rule, a round photo, name and firm, an outlined pill button below
centered heading, questions in two columns of pale rounded boxes with a plus sign, a centered underlined link to all questions below
grey band: a portrait of the founder left; heading, three short paragraphs and two pill buttons (the full story, the founder's book) right
heading and paragraph at the left, three article cards with a branded image, the title, category and date line in the accent, an excerpt and an underlined link
full-width brand-colour band: centered white heading, two short lines, one accent line, a white pill button and a line with two text links
